# Model for trade-execution optimization

A concept shared by **8** of the 14,225 algorithms in the [ranked algorithm list](../../algorithm_ledger.md#8c-the-ranked-algorithm-list-csv-import) (CSV import of 2026-10-27); its best-ranked member is #7,414. ## Description

Proposed model for trade-execution optimization: Plan order timing and slicing over an execution horizon to balance expected slippage, market impact, completion risk, and liquidity. This is a concept-level interpretation of the title, not a complete trading specification: the exact model inputs/target, calibration, entry/exit or rebalance rules, and position sizing are not fully defined here.
